name: TQO Research: Sources for Locked Rows

parameters.content:
## TQO Research
Ruled by Tee 2026-10-07: a research step, script doctor approve, a mechanical quote check under the doctor, Firecrawl.

Only locked Idea rows with no usable sources, two per run. It never changes status: a row with no approved source stays Idea and research_note says why. TQO FINAL V5 skips a locked row until sources exist.

Runs daily at 09:40Z, ruled by Tee 2026-10-07, 40 minutes before the 10:20Z writer. Timezone is UTC so the November clock change does not move it.
